name: Guinness
source: NGX filing library, Guinness Nigeria Plc statement to the Exchange on the audited results for the 18 months ended 31 December 2025 (NGN thousands, as printed). Source prints Cost of sales signed for the 18-month column and unsigned for the 12-month column; both are stored as printed. Operating Expenses is marketing plus distribution plus administrative expenses. Income Tax is stored so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals the printed profit for the period: FY2024 was a loss year and the filing shows a tax credit of 18,913,093, stored as negative. | CRON 20261001: Revenue FY2025 corrected 730,803,355 to 730,808,355 thousand, the figure the audited FY2025 statement prints: the row's own identity only ties with the corrected value (Revenue less Cost of Sales must equal the stored Gross Profit 230,481,949). EPS row added from the same statement, basic and diluted, in kobo (1,879 FY2025; -2,500 FY2024), matching the kobo convention of the other NGN files | FILL 20261007: H1 2026 cells added from Guinness Nigeria Plc unaudited condensed interim financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib), Group six months ended 30 June 2026 column, printed in N'000 and stored as absolute naira. Operating expenses is the sum of the printed administrative expenses 16,226,804 and marketing and distribution expenses 40,192,356. Net finance costs is the printed finance expenses 4,364,495 less the printed finance income 1,180,924. Ties exactly: revenue 265,042,881 less cost of sales 167,574,199 equals gross profit 97,468,682; gross profit plus other income 470,178 less 56,419,160 equals profit from operating activities 41,519,700; 41,519,700 less net finance costs 3,183,571 equals profit before tax 38,336,129; 38,336,129 less income tax 13,034,493 equals profit for the period 25,301,636.
source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47517_GUINNESS_NIG_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. | AUDIT 2026-10-04 (net-profit accuracy): the H1 2026 net profit was WITHHELD (set to null). This statement is stored in NGN '000 (the filing's printed unit), not absolute units, so the value renders 1000x too small under the platform's absolute convention. The audit rule requires the cell to equal the discovery record's profit_after_tax with the unit applied (absolute 25301636000); per fix-only-by-withholding it was nulled rather than rescaled. NOTE: the whole statement (revenue and every other row of this file) is stored in NGN '000 and needs block normalisation.
